tasks.label: Verify ShopMate local services
args: (async()=>{for(const u of ['http://localhost:5173/','http://127.0.0.1:8000/','http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health','http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/products','http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs']){try{const r=await fetch(u);const t=await r.text();console.log(`${r.status} ${u} (${t.length} bytes) ${t.slice(0,240).replace(/\s+/g,' ')}`);if(!r.ok)process.exitCode=1}catch(e){console.error(`FAIL ${u}: ${e.message}`);process.exitCode=1}}})()

tasks.label: Verify ShopMate services
args:
curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "frontend:%{http_code} %{size_download} bytes
" http://localhost:5173/ && curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "api-root:%{http_code} %{size_download} bytes
" http://127.0.0.1:8000/ && curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "health:%{http_code} %{size_download} bytes
" http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health && curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "products:%{http_code} %{size_download} bytes
" http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/products && curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "docs:%{http_code} %{size_download} bytes
" http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs

tasks.label: Confirm ShopMate HTTP status
args: curl.exe -f -sS -o NUL http://localhost:5173/ && echo frontend 200 && curl.exe -f -sS -o NUL http://127.0.0.1:8000/ && echo API-root 200 && curl.exe -f -sS -o NUL http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health && echo health 200 && curl.exe -f -sS -o NUL http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/products && echo products 200 && curl.exe -f -sS -o NUL http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs && echo docs 200
